_comment_token: Your bot token from https://discord.com/developers/applications — NEVER share this

welcome._comment_channelId: Right-click your welcome channel > Copy Channel ID (enable Developer Mode first)
welcome.message: Welcome to the server, {user}! We're glad to have you.

embed.title: Welcome to {server}!
embed.description: Hey {user}, welcome aboard! Make sure to read the rules and enjoy your stay.
embed._comment_thumbnailUrl: Leave empty to use the new member's avatar

_comment_reactionRoles: Map emoji to role IDs for reaction-based role assignment

reactionRoles._comment_messageId: The ID of the message users will react to
reactionRoles._comment_channelId: The channel that message lives in
reactionRoles._comment_map: Emoji (unicode or :name:) mapped to role IDs

moderation._comment_adminRoleId: Role ID that can use !warn and !kick
moderation._comment_logChannelId: Channel where mod actions are logged. Leave empty to disable

_comment_autoResponses: Trigger words and the bot's automatic reply. Case-insensitive.

autoResponses.hello: Hey there! 👋 How can I help you today?
autoResponses.invite: You can invite friends using: https://discord.gg/YOUR_INVITE

poll._comment_maxOptions: Maximum number of poll options (max 9 due to emoji limits)
poll._comment_allowedChannels: Channel IDs where !poll is allowed. Empty array = all channels
